reviews.title: Another “Free” Scam
reviews.text: Harvard advertises free courses through this platform but just like so many others, it’s simply not true. You get 3 weeks access to a 12 week course for free and then cut off or pay $300. THATS NOT FREE. Thats a free preview. Just pay the money to do an online course from an accredited college. Not some BS cert from a place that you would have to explain to an employer what it is.

reviews.title: New user but I enjoy
reviews.text: There sooo many different classes and subjects to learn. I’m sure the certifications you can purchase would be helpful with looking for certain jobs and look good on a resume but I mostly downloaded for curiosity to see what’s out there to learn and am  enjoying it heavily. It’s easy to maneuver, there’s sooo many different course options, just a lot you can experience for the affordable price of FREE! Which coming from the states, is rare for many of these types of classes and courses. I think any who have a natural curiosity and passion for learning should download. Theres also a discussion tab for most classes so if you’re a learner who likes interacting with others, that’s an option still for you. Just all around worth it.

reviews.title: 🔥This online university restored my connection to lifelong learning, and I am truly grateful🔥
reviews.text:
edX University provided me with an opportunity that had a real and lasting impact on my life.

Through their programs, I was able to learn for an entire year without financial burden at a time when returning to school felt uncertain and out of reach. That access mattered. It removed barriers and allowed me to re-engage with learning in a serious, meaningful way.

The courses were rigorous, thoughtfully designed, and genuinely challenging. More than anything, they helped restore my confidence in my ability to learn, grow, and move forward academically. Because of my experience with edX, I am now planning to return to school with renewed clarity and purpose.

I am sincerely grateful for the opportunity edX University provided and would recommend the platform to anyone seeking high-quality education and a genuine chance to invest in their future.
